psychological_meaning: Monarch is a deep, rich red that evokes feelings of passion, power, and sophistication. It suggests ambition and leadership while also hinting at a touch of mystery and luxury. It can represent courage, confidence, and a strong will, but also be associated with intensity and excitement.
